scope: Independently read MAINTENANCE.md, DATA_CONTRACT.md, the complete frozen rubric, seven reports and all relevant claims. lengthAssessment: Scores were assigned from capability evidence, not word count. All seven impact ratings from this reviewer fall within 5–7. Their 1858–1984 words fit that 2000-word band. Only the final independent mean impact determines the binding band; reassess length if the other review changes it.

sampledJudgments.evidence: Saved official October 22 announcement explicitly says generally available and documents native Live integration, caching and expansion from 200 to 400 questions. The report and decision preserve vendor-performance and no-runtime-testing boundaries. Inclusion is well supported.

The saved October 23 engineering article concerns Habitat/Cosmos DB tenancy, reliability, caching, geographic placement, Rust overhead and CDC at OpenAI scale. It offers useful infrastructure lessons but no directly tryable new AI model or tool. Exclusion from this builder-focused edition is defensible; it should remain discoverable as retained infrastructure context.
